messages:
sasha: kicking off a scoped design sync for the 'Recommendation Playbook' pilot. objective: combine offline simulation, advisor recommendations (batch/cache/quant), and eval-triggered alerts with a safe rollback UX. target 2 pilot tenants with contrasting SLAs.
tom: love it. reality check: replay jobs are expensive — propose sampling windows and a fast estimator to avoid full 48h replays for every iteration.
priya: for quality checks i'd like two signals: stewarded-set pass rate and semantic-similarity (cosine) between responses. rule example: \"if cosine < 0.94 on stewarded set over 500 samples -> alert\".
kevin: rollout plan: dry-run -> canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic hold if alerts fire. canary duration 2h default.
lina: customers expect visible \"why\" + revert. add a notes field explaining exact tokens saved and an auto-generated rollback message for CS to send.
sasha: proposed pilot acceptance thresholds (draft): cost reduction >= 10% on cost profile, p95 latency change <= +15ms for latency profile, stewarded-set alerting FPR <= 3%, rollback tested end-to-end.
tom: batching prototypes: throughput-first profile for cost tenants:
```json
{"profile":"throughput-first","max_batch_size":64,"max_wait_ms":150,"adaptive_backoff":true}
```
priya: quant rules: prefer recommending int8 if shadow-run divergence: top-k overlap >= 0.9 AND cosine >= 0.95. conservative fallback: recommend int8-with-merged-kv only.
kevin: caching guidance: conversation-prefix caching for repeated prompts, TTL=30s for hotspots, and a \"cache-only\" label so customers can opt in per route.
lina: add UX requirement: show confidence interval on cost savings (+/- %) and let customer set max_allowed_quality_loss. also include an exportable diff (before/after) + revert CTA.
sasha: action items: 1) sasha - write spec + acceptance checklist by Thu EOD, 2) tom - build estimator + sampling harness by Mon, 3) priya - shadow-run POC + divergence metrics by Mon, 4) kevin - console card mock + rollback flow by Mon, 5) lina - pilot comms + signoff template by Wed.
tom: infra blocker: will need a temporary replay quota and small staging pool for shadow runs. filing ENG-INFR ticket.
eval-bot: reminder: no heavy infra jobs allowed during maintenance window 2125000060-2125000300.
priya: also recommend adding suggested remediation text in alerts: e.g., \"suggested action: revert to previous quant config or enable cache-only mode for affected routes\". makes ops faster.
sasha: quick check: any objections to locking scope as-is so we can open RFC?
kevin: ack
lina: ack
priya: ack
tom: ack
eval-bot: sasha uploaded design-proposal.md to /specs/recommendation-playbook (https://redwood.dev/specs/recommendation-playbook)
